intent: TEST for TelemetryContracts. Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (StepVerifier for reactive types, Mockito for collaborators, WebTestClient for controllers) asserting ONLY the ast_hints API and the invariants below; cover happy paths, boundaries and error cases. Context: published language shared by Telemetry Intake, Chronology Reconciliation and Telemetry Record Ledger. Final non-instantiable holder class with nested public immutable types, the single producer of every cross-context type. Enums: MetricType {HEART_RATE, POWER, CADENCE, GROUND_CONTACT_TIME, RESPIRATION, SWIM_PACE}; ValidationStatus {VALID, VALIDATION_FAILED}; RevisionReason {ORIGINAL, CORRECTION, BACKFILL}. Records (all components non-null, NullPointerException otherwise): TelemetrySample(String deviceId, MetricType metricType, Instant tDevice, Instant tIngress, double value); TelemetrySampleValidated(TelemetrySample sample); TelemetrySampleValidationFailed(TelemetrySample sample, String reason); TelemetrySampleOrdered(TelemetrySample sample, ValidationStatus status); TelemetryBackfillDetected(TelemetrySample sample, ValidationStatus status, Duration lateness); TelemetryRecordAppended(String deviceId, MetricType metricType, Instant tDevice, int revision, RevisionReason reason); AppendFailed(String deviceId, MetricType metricType, Instant tDevice, String cause). tDevice is the authoritative ordering time; tIngress is never used for ordering. Pure value types, no methods beyond record accessors.
